entities.summary: Wong Kei-ying or Huang Qiying was a Chinese Hung Ga martial artist and physician of Cantonese ancestry. He was one of the Ten Tigers of Canton and was best known for his use of the Tiger Crane Paired Form Fist skill set. His son, Wong Fei-hung, who inherited his martial arts and medical skills, is commonly portrayed as a folk hero in Chinese popular culture.
